claims: Italy's Constitutional Court upheld Law 74/2025 on March 12, 2026.
Italy's Constitutional Court rejected challenges from the Tribunal of Turin.
Italy's Constitutional Court found the challenges to the restrictive law partly unfounded and partly inadmissible.
Italy's Constitutional Court upheld the Tajani Decree.
The Tajani Decree passed in March 2025.
For applications submitted after March 27, 2025, citizenship by descent is limited to those with a parent or grandparent born in Italy.
The changes apply to applications made after March 27, 2025.
The 2025 decree and subsequent ruling did not affect the approximately 60,000 applications already pending at consulates or in court at the time of the initial decree.
It is no longer possible to apply for citizenship by descent based on a great-grandparent or older ancestor unless the parent or grandparent born in Italy requirements are met.
